name: publicWeb_getMyRunsFor
description: The app's 'My runs for <kennel>' / 'My runs for <country>' drill-down (user_run_history_list_page.dart / user_country_history_list_page.dart), server-side. One row per run — and per non-cancelled payment where a run has more than one, exactly as the app's LEFT JOIN. @allRuns = 1 is the app's All Runs toggle: attendance >= 0 instead of >= 20, so every counted run of the kennel / country appears, with the member's row where one exists. The run's country is Event.CountryId, so a travelling kennel's runs sit under several countries. Counted, visible, non-removed runs that have started; no Event.deleted filter, to match the app. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 114, @param NULL); scoped to the token's user. Read-only.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The browser's HC.Device id. No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token signed for this SP (ValidateAppAuth spNumber 114). No SQL default.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: The kennel (live). Give this OR @countryId; an unknown kennel with no @countryId → 1240.

parameters.name: countryId
parameters.description: The country (HC.Country.id, the RUN's Event.CountryId). Used when @publicKennelId is NULL or unknown. Not validated — an unknown id returns success with an empty header and no runs.

parameters.name: allRuns
parameters.description: 0 = my runs (AttendenceState >= 20, default); 1 = all counted runs.

rowsets.name: AuthErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: On a ValidateAppAuth failure: { success = 0, errorCode, errorType } then the detail at index 1; the SP RETURNs.
Error detail after the AuthErrorEnvelope (errorId, errorType, errorCode, errorTitle, errorUserMessage, errorProc).

rowsets.name: NotFoundEnvelope
rowsets.description: When neither a live kennel nor a @countryId is given: { success = 0, errorCode = 1240, errorType = 12 } then the detail at index 1 (logged to HC.ErrorLog); RETURN.
After NotFoundEnvelope: 1240 / 12, 'Not found', 'That kennel or country could not be found.' (no debugMessage column).

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: On success, before the data rowsets: { success = 1, errorCode = NULL, errorType = NULL }.

rowsets.name: Header
rowsets.description: On success: one row. Kind = 'kennel' (kennel columns filled, country columns NULL) when @publicKennelId resolved; else Kind = 'country' (country columns filled, kennel columns NULL — zero rows for an unknown @countryId). The NULL literals in the other branch are untyped.

columns.name: KennelCredit
columns.description: The caller's credit at the kennel.

rowsets.name: Runs
rowsets.description: On success: one row per matching run (and per non-cancelled, non-removed HC.Payment on the member's HasherEventMap row), ORDER BY EventStartDatetimeGmt DESC, EventNumber DESC. The app's UserRunHistoryModel columns, camelCase.

columns.name: totalRunsThisKennel
columns.description: HasherEventMap.TotalRunsThisKennel — the member's run count at this run.

columns.name: eventStartDatetime
columns.description: CAST(Event.EventStartDatetime AS datetime2(7)) — local wall clock.

columns.name: packOffMinutes
columns.description: Effective pack-off (E3.F1.S6): minutes after the gather — the run's own, else the kennel's default; NULL = the pack leaves at the gather.

columns.name: hemId
columns.description: HasherEventMap.id; NULL for a run the member has no row for (allRuns = 1).

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog on the 1240 not-found path and in the CATCH (then THROW).

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId and @accessToken have no SQL default (lines 2-3). A caller that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs — an empty 500 with no HC.ErrorLog row (CLAUDE.md 'SP parameter with NO default'). The Next.js client always sends them, so this is latent.

codeSmells.issue: 'Exactly one' of kennel / country not enforced
codeSmells.detail: The header says exactly one of @publicKennelId / @countryId, but both may be given (both filters apply, kennel header) and an unknown @countryId is not checked — success with an empty header rowset and no runs instead of 1240.

creditAmount / debitAmount / creditAvailable / KennelCredit pass through HC.Payment / HasherKennelMap SMALLMONEY columns, where CLAUDE.md wants DECIMAL(10,4). A table-level issue surfaced here, not introduced by the SP.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
